Great Lakes Family Dental located in Saginaw, Michigan opened its doors in 1938 right after the first NYLON toothbrush had been invented! Providing 84 years of dental care to the historic “Old Town” district, Great Lakes Family Dental has undergone many changes but our dedication to our patients has remained the same. As you enter our lobby you are greeted by the steady flow of sunshine that pours through our cathedral-shaped windows creating a beautiful and welcoming environment. Our large practice with several providers allows us to offer the convenience of same day and same time appointments for multiple family members.

Our dentists and dental specialists provide a full range of dental services in a comfortable welcoming setting. Preventive care such as digital x-rays and cleanings and more advanced services like braces and root canals are available in-house with no need for a referral.

Our Great Lakes Family Dental Saginaw dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services. By staying on top of the latest advances in dental care with continuing education and training, patients can feel confident in the high-quality care they receive. Building long-standing, trusting relationships with patients is a key part of overall care.

Whether you're new to town, need to get back on track with your dental care, or are looking for a more convenient dentist, our team will listen and provide personalized care tailored to your health. Great Lakes Family Dental Saginaw and all of our Great Lakes Family Dental offices are safely seeing patients with all guidelines in place.

Yes. You should visit the dentist. We provide extensive care and serve patients in Saginaw, Lexington, and Winchester and anyone from beyond these areas who seeks Great Lakes Family Dental care.

Great Lakes Family Dental Saginaw is a friendly dentist office in Saginaw that provides comprehensive dental care to its patients. Your search for an affordable dentist office near home ends here. Great Lakes Family Dental Saginaw sees emergency dental cases the same day as it can be acutely painful and discomforting for the patient. Great Lakes Family Dental Saginaw provides emergency dental services and tends to dental emergencies such as chipped, cracked, or missing teeth, a tooth or Gum Abscess, toothache, mouth pain, bitten/cut tongue or cheek, broken braces wires or brackets, jaw pain and other such dental emergencies cases. Great Lakes Family Dental Saginaw provides emergency care that can help alleviate your pain and discomfort and help prevent permanent damage or bone loss. Just call to schedule a dental emergency appointment today.
